Section  13  of  the  principal  enactment  is  hereby
amended as follows:-

(1)
by  the  repeal  of  the  definition  of  the  expression
“distributor”  and  the  substitution  therefor  of  the
following  definition:-
““distributor” in relation to any manufacturer
or  producer  or  importer  of  any  goods  in

Sri  Lanka  means 
any 
person 
or

partnership, 
appointed 
by 
such
manufacturer or producer or importer for
the sale in the wholesale market, of such
goods, at such price as may be determined
by  such  manufacturer  or  producer  or
importer, from time to time;”; and

(2)
by  the  repeal  of  definition  of  the  expression
“Inland Revenue Act” and the substitution therefor,
of the following definition:-
““Inland  Revenue  Act”  means  the  Inland
Revenue Act, No. 24 of 2017 as the case
may be or any successor thereto providing
for the taxation of income;”.
